common_ground.text: No new ZCG wing is needed right now.
Regional communities matter and more funding would help them.
Small groups starting at ZecHub, then moving to direct ZCG funding, is how Zcash Brazil and Zcash en Español grew.

output.headline: How to fund new Zcash Ambassadors and emerging communities: scale ZecHub's route or add a ZCG wing
output.next: The temporary ZecHub sub-DAO draft proposal is discussed in a separate thread; yoditar says they will review it.

stakes.decision: Whether to set up a temporary ZecHub sub-DAO to incubate Ambassadors and emerging communities (draft proposal in a separate thread).

unresolved.text: Does ZecHub have the funding and capacity to run the incubation stage, and do its unpaid DAO members need more time or pay if it grows?
Does ZecHub want the incubation role at all? vaspholdings backs it only 'if the ZecHub team wants it'.
How do the draft ZecHub sub-DAO proposal and the three alternative approaches compare?

best_against.quote: Having a wing dedicated to community grants, backed by a ZIP, could be one way to ensure this work continues.

best_for.quote: I would put the extra resources into people doing the work, not more people governing ZCG.

views.label: The ZecHub-to-ZCG route works; scale it
views.one_line: ZecHub incubates new Ambassadors and communities, then ZCG funds them once established. Fund that route better; do not add another ZCG committee.

best_for.quote: Doing all of the above significantly increases the number of groups that start popping up and does so at a very low cost. In-person groups/events are very valuable as they are where people build trust and relationships.

views.label: Make starting a group cheap and easy
views.one_line: Give new groups guides, a little ZEC after an event or two, a support contact, a private chat and a directory. It costs little and builds trust in person.

best_for.quote: become more intentional about recognizing people already showing leadership, supporting and mentoring them, and helping them grow into the next generation of community leaders?

views.label: Learn from the Ambassador history and grow leaders
views.one_line: The Global Ambassador Program also produced community leaders. Recognise and mentor people already showing leadership, and build a clear path from early activity to funded work.

best_against.quote: But it spends a delegated, capped budget on smaller local decisions, where many voices genuinely help. ZCG can resize that budget each year. Adding permanent ZCG seats is a much heavier commitment.

best_for.quote: Having a wing dedicated to community grants, backed by a ZIP, could be one way to ensure this work continues. I mention this because some past ZCG candidates have floated the idea of cutting the budget for regional communities.

views.label: No wing now, but a community wing could protect funding
views.one_line: The two-wing idea is not needed now, but a community wing backed by a ZIP could keep regional funding secure. ZecHub's unpaid DAO would need more time if its role grew.

output.why_it_matters: Decides who funds new Ambassadors and local communities. ZecHub's 2026 Ambassador allocation is 20 ZEC, down from 400 ZEC in 2025, per vaspholdings.
